integrity: Analytic proof for every stated parameter; finite rational tests are supplemental and not proof of continuum coverage. All cited source publication dates refer to verified initial public availability.
scientific_limitations: Real Hilbert metric embeddings only, with exactly two equilateral blocks of sizes at least two and a uniform cross distance. The older equal-intrablock bipartite-graph snowflake case is already covered by Robertson (2023); the independently varying block formula, complete split specialization, and equality/affine-dimension classification are the contribution under review. No assertion of exhaustive historical priority or independent validation.
title: Exact Hilbert distortion and optimizer rigidity for two equilateral blocks
